notes.subject: וטמא
notes.rationale: Hobane o hlotse — verb 'to declare unclean' (ho hloka/ho loka ha moprista), eseng ho bontsha bohlale bo boholo feela.

notes.subject: פשה תפשה
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute + finite verb ya motso o le mong (פשה/תפשה): 'ha e phalla tlhaho' — tswelelopele e phahamitseng e phelwang ka ho pheta.

notes.subject: נגע
notes.rationale: 'Negae' — motho o tlotsweng kapa tlelase; 'infection' kapa 'plague' ha e boloke sebopeho sa motho o tlotsweng.

translation: Mme ha e phalla haholo letlalong, moprista a tla mo tlwaetsa hore o hlotse: e le negae.

tokens.gloss: a mo tlwaetsa hore o hlotse
